title: Tribunus Structured Log Contract
description: All production logs must be structured JSON with trace correlation. No raw console.log or printf-debugging in production paths.

service.description: Subsystem name (coordination, session, tool, provider, http, cockpit, desktop)

trace_id.description: W3C Trace Context trace ID for correlation

enforcement.production: All log output MUST use structured JSON format. No console.log, printf, or raw string logging.
enforcement.development: Structured JSON encouraged but not enforced. Debug output may use console.log for ergonomics.
enforcement.linting: Linter rules detect raw console.log in production paths and fail CI.
enforcement.redaction: Log entries MUST NOT contain: file contents, user secrets, PII, session tokens, or raw API keys. Redaction is applied at the log emitter.

levels.trace: Extremely detailed debugging. Disabled in production by default.
levels.debug: Developer-relevant information. Disabled in production by default.
levels.info: Normal operational events. Default production level.
levels.warn: Potential issues that do not block operation.
levels.fatal: System-crashing errors that halt the process.
